First, property income tax. From 6th April 2027, rental profit gets its own tax rates. The basic rate goes from 20 % to 22%, the higher rate from 40 % to 42 % and the additional rate from 45 % to 47%.
This was announced at last November's budget and it became law in March this year.
The tax credit you get on mortgage interest also goes up from 20 % to 22%. So landlords with bigger mortgages feel slightly less of the increase.
There's also a change to how your personal allowance is used. From April 2027 it goes against your salary first, and only then against your rental income.
